journal_lines: The shaft went deeper than it should have. Came back with mud on the paws and something extra.
Someone else's tunnel. Old supports, old cart tracks. Fresh ore behind the rot.
Mineshaft, abandoned. The tools were still there. The ore was still there too.
The old rails still ran true. Followed them to where the work was left.
Chest at the end of the passage. Someone planned to come back. Came back for them.
The mineshaft went sideways into a rich vein. They ran out of time. I didn't.
Spider webs thick as a curtain across the entrance. Behind them: untouched ore.
Old survey marks on the wall. Whoever made them knew what they were doing. Finished their work.
The tunnel was structurally sound. Just abandoned. Everything they left, still there.
Torch holders every ten paces. The surveying was thorough. The follow-through wasn't.
Old cart still on the rails, half-loaded. Finished loading it.
The mine was sealed from outside. Something different about that. Opened it anyway.
